text:
jen: Heads-up — saw another json-mode fncall shape mismatch in the onboarding sampler. App expects an object but sometimes gets a list. Hitting samplekit tests.

marco: any repro steps or stack traces?

jen: Repro: run samplekit onboarding with network fault injection (flip 502 after 2 tokens). Call looks like: ```js
client.call({ model: 'redwood-medium', mode: 'json', function: 'parse_meta', jsonSchema: metaSchema, input })
```
Intermittent response: `[ { meta: {...} } ]` vs `{ meta: {...} }`. Downstream validator chokes.

olivia: Do we see this only in Node? Python seems fine in my quick checks.

sam: Confirmed Node v1.8.x reproduces. Python v0.9.x returns the unwrapped object. Definitely an SDK parity gap.

marco: My guess: retry/streaming join path accumulates parsed fragments into an array and a later step forgets to unbox when the schema expects an object.

jen: Filing an issue with a tiny harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/issues/1599 (contains harness and deterministic 502 scenario).

olivia: Short-term mitigation we pushed to samplekit: small helper `normalizeJsonFncall` that coerces safe shapes. Example:```js
function normalizeJsonFncall(parsed, schema) {
  if (schema?.type === 'object' && Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length === 1) return parsed[0];
  return parsed;
}
```
We added this to samplekit until SDK patch lands.

sam: Sounds good. Please make the helper log a metric `jsonmode.coerce.single_element` so we can measure how common this is.

ci-bot: :warning: samplekit/onboard-fuzz reported 7 parse anomalies in last 6h

marco: Plan: olivia to open a small defensive PR in node-sdk that ensures the final return shape matches declared schema for simple cases (object vs array) without hiding multi-element arrays. jen to add e2e in samplekit harness that forces retry. sam to review.

olivia: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/912 — adds a narrowly-scoped normalization step only when `mode==='json' && function_call && schema.type==='object'` and only if the parsed value is a single-element array. Includes unit tests and an integration run against the harness.

jen: Add changelog note and include a short migration blurb: "If your app relies on json-mode fncall outputs, consider adding a defensive normalize helper prior to upgrading; samplekit includes a safe helper."

marco: Long-term: we should standardize SDK behavior across languages — either strict schema errors or explicit, documented coercions. I'll put an RFC on the agenda for next sprint. For now, narrow safe coercion + metrics.

support-bot: :memo: Suggested support blurb: "If you see parse errors with json-mode fncall, upgrade Node SDK to the patch release or apply the samplekit normalize helper. Contact eng-devex for repro access."

sam: Thanks all. If anyone wants to validate against the flaky staging harness ping me for creds.

(ends)
